Use case: stylized-concept. National cultural heritage travel illustration in the visual style of Day of the Tentacle adventure-game backgrounds with strongly exaggerated wonky angular architecture, crooked perspective and thick dark plum ink contours, combined with sculpted cel-shaded 3D volume, soft cast shadows, ambient occlusion and visible layered depth. NOT a realistic photo. Clear foreground/middle/background separation for parallax shader presentation, atmospheric distant scenery, bold silhouettes and rich organized details. Use real recognizable landmarks from the specified country only, regionally accurate natural animals in separate appropriate habitats. No invented landmark combinations presented as a literal place: this is explicitly a national travel montage. Natural animals without clothes, anthropomorphism or silly expressions. No octopuses, tentacles, fantasy creatures, silly characters or people. No words, lettering, flags, logos, watermarks or national emblems. STRICT EVERYWHERE even tiny skyline: no mosque, minaret, Islamic religious architecture, Islamic symbols, religious crescents, Islamic inscriptions or calligraphy. Civilian background houses only. Authentic Christian churches/cathedrals, Buddhist/Hindu temples, synagogues and ancient sacred monuments ARE allowed and encouraged when significant; do not exclude permitted landmarks merely because religious. Represent listed authentic regional sites without inventing extra religious buildings. Final composition is a broad representative regional selection, never all districts or exhaustive heritage. Keep every primary landmark roof and all animal silhouettes fully inside frame, with margins. Country: Cape Verde. Palette from supplied collection: #87BDA5 #B9DD83 #D5D88C #A5C885, supported by muted natural stone, wood and vegetation colors with purple shadows. Show these authentic landmarks in distinct regional clusters: Cidade Velha pillory and secular ruins (Santiago); Royal Fort of São Filipe (Santiago); Pico do Fogo (Fogo); Mindelo civic waterfront (São Vicente); Paul valley terraces (Santo Antão); Sal salt pans (Sal). Natural animals in appropriate separate habitats: loggerhead turtle on beaches, Cape Verde shearwater. Local plants: dragon tree, date palm. Small optional authentic craft/food detail: woven pano cloth. Cover panorama3:1 final1500x500. Clear broad region clusters from left to right, animal foreground near lower-right and plants lower-left; ample upper breathing room, mountains and sky far behind.
CRITICAL medium: thick dark plum cartoon outline strokes, wonky angular secular walls and volcano facets, chunky sculpted3D pastel broad cel shading, no photographic textures. Cape Verde island regional montage in wide3:1 format. Pillory column stone with iron rings, low bastioned Sao Filipe fort, volcanic Fogo and Paul terraces, salt pans and Mindelo civic waterfront. No extra religious buildings. Near loggerhead turtle on sandy coastal lower-right, entire four-flipper silhouette within margin; shearwater in flight. Dragon tree/date palm foreground left.
Edit: Correct ONLY the foreground-left Cidade Velha pillory column: replace the massive tan rectangular pillar and oversized rings with authentic slender WHITE MARBLE Manueline pillory. Tall narrow twisted spiral-fluted shaft on three octagonal steps, small cylindrical decorated capital, four small curved dark iron bars near top and pinecone-shaped stone finial. A single small iron attachment ring midway. This is a civic historic column, not a religious tower. Keep all other landmarks, turtle, bird, tree, colors, thick cartoon style and composition unchanged. No text or symbols.
